requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The customer should see only one unique product name/reference for HP OJP 9010 series on 123.hp.com and support.hp.com, to reduce confusion and user errors caused by multiple naming variations.

requirements.Requirement: Printer able to run all new/current EM / market segment media
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must function reliably with all new and current EM (ElectroMagnetic) and market segment-specific media types, meeting the intervention specification for different media and climatic conditions for the Manhattan platform.

requirements.Requirement: Product can be placed and work on uneven surface ( sofa , table cloth , carpet …)
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The product must operate correctly when placed on uneven surfaces such as sofas, table cloths, or carpets, without failure of the input tray sensor flag or similar components.

requirements.Requirement: Tilt left and right each while printing
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer should be evaluated for functional failures when tilted 20 degrees left or right during printing, as per CISS product test standards.

requirements.Requirement: Put printer on trolley and print
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must maintain print quality and reliable operation when printing while placed on a moving trolley, in accordance with standard UBT requirements.
